'''May 2001 Minneapolis tournament (22 May)''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Mirkwood, Minneapolis, Minnesota on 22 May 2001. It is known from Justin Alfs's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2359">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-05-22-moffwicket-goes-to-mirkwood-5-22-01d2359/ moffwicket-goes-to-mirkwood-5-22-01], DeckTech (Justin "MoffWicket" Alfs, 22 May 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-05-22-moffwicket-goes-to-mirkwood-5-22-01d2359/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 22 May 2001
* '''Site:''' Mirkwood, Minneapolis, Minnesota
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
